blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City police have recovered a Mitsubishi Montero during a follow-up operation in Mandaluyong City, they said on Wednesday. In a report, the Quezon City Police District (QCPD) said its operatives seized the 2024 Mitsubishi Montero in response to a victim’s complaint filed at the District Anti-Carnapping Unit on Sept. 17. READ: 4 arrested as stolen councilor’s car intercepted in Nueve Vizcaya According to the QCPD, the suspect, identified as alias “Alex,” entered into a deed of sale with assumption of mortgage with the victim for the vehicle but supposedly failed to fulfill the agreement’s terms later.
